property_summary: For any actor, any positive deposit and any lock time, after a successful Put the deposited ether is recorded so that a later Collect of the full amount (once unlocked) pays it out and leaves the contract holding zero ether; the mutant never records the deposit, so Collect does nothing and the contract keeps the full amount.
change_summary: Delete the statement `acc.balance += msg.value;` so the deposited balance is never recorded.
